pages.title: Bubble March
pages.text:
■ Bubble March is a board game Little Mermaid created using bubbles.
■ Minions and Raptures advance forward to destroy each other's towers.
■ Win by protecting the allies' towers and destroying the Rapture towers!

pages.title: Summoning
pages.text:
■ Summon heroes and minions to fight against the invading Raptures.
■ You'll need Summon Bubbles to call them into battle.
■ Summon Bubbles automatically refill over time and can also be obtained by defeating Raptures.
■ Collect a specific number of Summon Bubbles to summon heroes and minions.

pages.title: Minion
pages.text:
■ Minions advance forward to fight Raptures and defend the allies' towers.
■ Multiple minions are summoned at once.
■ Upgrading the level increases the number of minions summoned at a time.
■ Advanced minions can be unlocked through research.
■ Different minions have an advantage against different types of Raptures. Please refer to the description of the minions.

pages.title: Hero
pages.text:
■ A hero is summoned one at a time.
■ A hero on the battlefield cannot be summoned again.
■ Learn the hero's unique trait to use powerful skills.
■ New heroes can be unlocked through research.

pages.title: Hero & Minion Upgrade
pages.text:
■ Summon Bubbles can be used to enhance and upgrade the levels of heroes and minions in the stage.
■ The higher their level, the more powerful the heroes and minions will become.
■ As the battle progresses, the Raptures' levels will also increase.
■ All enhanced levels will be reset after the battle.

pages.title: Summon Bubble Upgrade
pages.text:
■ Summon Bubbles can also be enhanced.
■ Enhancing Summon Bubbles will increase the maximum amount of Summon Bubbles in a stage.

pages.title: Allies' Towers
pages.text:
■ Raptures will invade and attack the allies' towers.
■ The battle is lost when the allies' towers are destroyed.
■ Heroes and minions must be summoned strategically to protect the allies' towers.

pages.title: Rapture Towers
pages.text:
■ The battle is won when Rapture towers are destroyed or when the Rapture boss is defeated.
■ Rapture towers or bosses may appear multiple times in some stages.

pages.title: Stages
pages.text:
■ Bubble March has four difficulty modes: Easy, Normal, Hard, and Challenge.
■ Various types of heroes and minions can be used in the stages.

pages.title: Waves
pages.text:
■ Each stage consists of at least one wave.
■ If a stage has multiple waves, all waves must be cleared to win.
■ Heroes and minions that survive the previous wave can be used in the next wave.
■ The higher the difficulty, the more waves there will be.

pages.title: Challenge
pages.text:
■ The Challenge stage has unlimited waves.
■ Upgrade research and traits to enhance your heroes and minions, in order to clear as many waves as possible!

pages.title: Stage Progression
pages.text:
■ When all Easy stages are cleared, the stage will begin from Wave 3.
■ When all Normal stages are cleared, the stage will begin from Wave 6.
■ When all Hard stages are cleared, the stage will begin from Wave 9.

pages.title: Research
pages.text:
■ New heroes and minions can be unlocked through research.
■ Research Bubbles are required to conduct research.
■ Research Bubbles can be obtained from the first clear rewards of some stages.

pages.title: Reset
pages.text:
■ Research can be reset.
■ If you're having trouble clearing a stage, consider researching heroes and minions that counter Raptures that will appear in battle.

pages.title: Traits
pages.text:
■ Traits provide advantages in battles.
■ If the stage is too difficult, try upgrading the traits.
■ Trait Bubbles are required to learn and upgrade traits.
■ Trait Bubbles can be obtained repeatedly by clearing stages.

pages.title: Reset
pages.text:
■ Traits can be reset.
■ Combine different traits to create your own winning strategy!

view.summary: A lane battle: summon bubble minions and fairy-tale heroes with Summon Bubbles, march them at the Raptures and destroy the Rapture tower or boss of each wave while keeping your own tower standing.

overview.title: A battle
items: Destroy the Rapture tower (or defeat the boss) in every wave of the stage before time runs out.

Tap a unit to summon it for Summon Bubbles; it appears in front of your tower and marches on its own. Minions come out several at a time and can be summoned again after a cooldown; each hero can be on the field only once.

Refill on their own during battle (charge value 10; the in-game text gives no unit) and drop from defeated Raptures (10 to 20 each). Start cap 1,000; each Summon Bubble level costs 100 and raises the cap by 1,000.

Summon Bubbles also level up each unit type for the rest of the battle: more ATK and HP, and more minions per summon (4, then 5 from Lv 11, 6 from Lv 21). Levels reset after the battle; the stage sets the level cap.
Units deal +50% damage to the Rapture types they counter (see the unit and Rapture pages).
Heroes and minions that survive carry over to the next wave. Rapture levels go up each wave.
The rerun (Arcade) has the same stages with no day locks and its own set of challenge missions.
